question_text: Draw a line segment of length 7.6 cm and divide it in the ratio 5:8. Measure the two parts. Give the justification of the construction.

question_image.description: Diagram showing the construction of a line segment divided in the ratio 5:8.

answer_text: A line segment of length 7.6 cm can be divided in the ratio of 5:8 as follows. Step 1: Draw line segment AB of 7.6 cm and draw a ray AX making an acute angle with line segment AB. Step 2: Locate 13 points on AX such that each segment is equal. Step 3: Join BA. Step 4: Through point A, draw a line parallel to BA intersecting AB at point C. C divides line segment AB in the required ratio.

steps.description: Draw line segment AB of 7.6 cm and a ray AX making an acute angle.
Locate 13 points on AX such that each segment is equal.
Join point B to point A.
Draw a line through point A parallel to BA intersecting AB at point C.

final_answer: C is the point dividing line segment AB of 7.6 cm in the required ratio of 5:8.
